scope: HJ0 candidate result closure and bounded observation partition. No production methods or state transitions are implemented here.
notes: The shared write union does not assert that every tag is reachable for every method. Method rows list only supported business branches.
query projection/page/found are table labels for successful outputs, not additional proposed wire discriminants.
Business state transitions, authority protection, and SQL durability remain model and implementation obligations.
A process crash may produce no response; finite totalization assumes a running process and effective budget scheduling.
